rows.what: The front-porch session: Mike in the wicker chair, guitar, the Audigo on a stand; one static portrait frame for 22 minutes. Three full takes of Coconuts, one false start, an abandoned E.D. Yahdah, and his talk between takes ("we're here for reels"). Never logged anywhere until today.
rows.why: Real performance with a real microphone (24-bit), portrait, already the Number's shape. The frame is wide and he is small in it; the room noise is the landscapers and the cicadas, which he names on tape. The takes are complete enough to cut pieces from today (see the pieces below).
rows.decision: A the session is Number material: Ops cuts pieces from take 1 and take 3 by the ruled piece list (hook, verse, bridge, the story, hook again) · B keep for the live-single rehearsal reference only; shoot the Number fresh with the DJI pair · C discard: the frame is too wide
rows.note: The take map, from the transcript: talk and setup 0:15 to 7:40; false starts 7:43 to 9:30; TAKE 1 10:05 to 12:07 (clean, his own verdict 'that was coconuts'); TAKE 2 12:44 to 16:20 (breaks at 14:26, restarts from the bridge); TAKE 3 18:05 to 20:05 ('a couple of screw ups'); E.D. Yahdah attempt 20:20 to 22:24 ('I gotta practice that more').
